exact_statement: For every finite uniform Boolean sign f, C>0, c>=2/ln(2), and nonempty proper original coordinate block A of size r, retain every complete physical child g_x, t=E a(g_x), R=E I(g_x)-t, D=H(f)-C I(f), S=E[C a(g_x)-H(g_x)], sigma=I_A(f), and J=H(f)-E H(g_x)-H(Z_A|Z_B). With theta=1/(1+2^(C-c)), Q=Ber(theta)^r, W=D_2(P_AB||Q tensor P_B), and G=c sigma-J, the exact identity is D+S+C R+W+G=r log2(1+2^(c-C)), with R,W,G>=0. At a least-essential-dimension positive-C-deficit witness S>=0, so W+G+C R+S is strictly below this capacity. For any nontrivial A-event with occupation v and Q-probability q, W=d2(v||q)+v W1+(1-v)W0, retaining unconditional P_B in both conditional references. Thus v>=eta*capacity implies W1<1/eta for eta>0 at such a critical witness. No such occupation lower bound is asserted. Actual point defects at C_n=n,c=3 have W->0 but occupied W1>=n/2-2 for n>=3; they are not high-C critical witnesses. Shifted-threshold terminal errors H-Ka<=epsilon a use C=K+epsilon and finite minimality, without an infinite optimizer.
